newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's TIIE 28-day rate rises to 20.40 pct.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's TIIE 28-day rate rises to 20.40 pct.

text.p: Mexico's 28-day interbank interest rate for Monday, July 21, was fixed at 20.4000 percent, or an increase of 18.00 basis points from 20.2200 percent, the rate for July 18, Banco de Mexico said on Friday.
The 28-day TIIE is a market-weighted average interbank rate that is revised each working day, and is valid for the day after it is set.
The new rate will be published in Monday's edition of the Mexican government's Official Gazette.
